text:
maya: Heads up, sample-app fails with json_mode=strict + wrapToolCall when token refresh happens. Duplicate fn-call + schema reject.

maya: Error:
```
Error: schema validation failed: unexpected property '_retryMeta' at /tools/0/output
```

maya: stack points to wrapToolCall at helpers/wrapToolCall.js:118

maya: Repro steps (local):
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood/sample-app.git
cd sample-app
# point to local SDK patch
REDWOOD_SDK_LOCAL=/path/to/sdk yarn start:dev
# trigger endpoint to simulate 401 then success
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/_internal/test-auth-retry -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"json_mode":"strict","simulate_401":true}'
```

tom: probably the auth retry merges metadata into the tool output. which sdk version?

maya: @redwood/sdk v0.10.1 (package.json)

li: yep, v0.10.x had a shallow merge bug where `_retryMeta` landed in the response object. fixed on main but not backported.

maya: quick test: adding an idempotency header `x-rw-id` stopped duplicate executions for me, but the schema still fails because of the `_retryMeta` field.

tom: mitigation: SDK helper should clone the tool output and strip internal keys (prefix `_`) before calling the json schema validator when json_mode==='strict'.

li: I'll open SDK-487 and prepare a patch branch fix/strip-retrymeta-v0.10.x. small change: deepClone(output); for (k in obj) if k.startsWith('_') delete obj[k]; validate(obj)

ci-bot: CI queued: sample-app -> tests/auth-retry

maya: I'll add an integration test in sample-app/tests/fixtures that simulates token endpoint 401 then success and asserts a single tool invocation and no `_` prefixed keys in the final response. creating TEST-160.

tom: also add env knob REDWOOD_DEV_DEDUPE=false to disable dedupe header locally (helps debugging).

li: PR will include changelog note about adding `x-rw-id` dedupe semantics and the stricter strip behavior. tagging @maya @tom for review.

maya: thanks — will verify on staging once PR lands. :thumbsup:
